title_suffix: Loop Engineering for goals: session-bound loops, /goal bridge, and triage
summary: This minor release turns ospec goal into a session-bound Loop with a verifiable plan-act-observe cycle, capability-probed /goal bridging, safety levels (L1/L2/L3), and a triage inbox. ospec change is unchanged and keeps the classic fast flow.
new: ospec goal now creates a session-bound Loop (artifacts/loop/loop.json, state.json, run-log.jsonl) with a safety level chosen at creation via --level L1|L2|L3 (default L1).

Added ospec loop run/watch/status/pause/resume/level/tick-plan to drive the controller-driven two-phase tick or the CLI-driven in-process watcher; both are session-bound and stop with pause, a STOP sentinel, or closing the session.
Added ospec triage list/claim/promote with a managed triage inbox (<managed>/triage/inbox.jsonl) where L1 findings and out-of-allowlist items surface instead of being applied silently.

Added ospec execute launch --primitive subagent|goal|loop with --until/--max-iterations/--interval to bridge to a harness-native /goal (Claude, Codex) or a capability-probed emulated-goal verify-driven loop.
improved: Verification is now exposed as a non-exiting VerificationService that returns a structured outcome; VerifyCommand is a thin wrapper that owns console output and the exit code, so loops can consume verification without terminating.

Harness loop primitives are capability-probed at runtime (CapabilityProbeService) instead of assuming /loop or CronCreate; external agent CLI calls use claude -p and codex exec (never claude --goal) via AgentCliRunnerService.
docs: Added docs/loop-engineering.md and docs/dev/loop-execution-model-contract.md, and updated the ospec-goal skill and usage guide for the Loop model.
Localized the goal / Loop capability across the README and usage guide in en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP, and ar.
